title: You in your yard
lines: In The Works you walk round your yard as yourself, in your own skin. WASD or the arrow keys walk, and holding them runs; the view follows you. On a phone, tap the ground to walk there.
You build and remove within reach: the plot you stand on and the 8 around it. From the yard's middle plot that is the whole yard.

more.head: Also
points: Belts, splitters, joiners, sorters and tunnels are walked over. Machines, the depot, redwoods and the stream are walked around.
Drag the yard to look elsewhere. Walking, or Space, brings the view back to you.
A tap on a piece still opens its card. Turning a piece, a card's settings, painting a line and Upgrade on a marked area work from anywhere.
